summary: The trial timed out (score=0) but the app was actually building and running with 57.1% parity (4/7 scenarios passing). The agent spent ~40 of its 116 turns fighting a subst-drive package registration issue unrelated to the migration itself. Once resolved, the remaining failures were all due to MediaPlayerElement not exposing AutomationId through UIA — a tooling/detection issue rather than a missing feature. The agent was in the process of fixing this (wrapping in Grid) when it timed out. With the subst-drive issue pre-resolved, this migration would likely have scored 80-100%.
